senses.sense_definition: A person who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle.

examples.text: The <w>rider</w> wore a helmet and leather jacket while operating the motorcycle.

target_lang_translations.zh: 技术娴熟的<w>骑手</w>只需极其细微的动作就能控制马匹。

senses.sense_definition: A person who travels in a vehicle or uses public transport; a passenger.

senses.sense_definition: An amendment to an entertainer's contract specifying personal requirements like food or equipment.

examples.text: The band's hospitality <w>rider</w> requested specific brands of bottled water and fresh fruit.

target_lang_translations.nl: De hospitality <w>rider</w> van de band vroeg om specifieke merken flessenwater en vers fruit.

target_lang_translations.de: Der Hospitality-<w>Rider</w> der Band forderte bestimmte Marken von Mineralwasser und frisches Obst.

examples.text: The venue manager reviewed the technical <w>rider</w> to ensure all sound equipment was available.
